examples.scenario: Title: Laura Opens the Review Notes Scenario: What if the red cell is not a formatting issue? Laura sits with the forecast deck and sealed review notes before the public model review. She must decide whether to open the file as a verdict or as information, so she writes, "I am competent and this model may contain an error and I can learn from it."
